entries.339b67f14440a866: This business operates local businesses (restaurants) through CS-R Co.,Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary, and its subsidiary Predia Co.,Ltd. It advances store expansion by leveraging resources developed in the Local Business DX Business, such as marketing support and know-how for multi-store expansion, talent recruitment and development, and finance, and practical insights and operating know-how gained from operations are returned to the Local Business DX Business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥281 million.
entries.3e5366b54006c5da: It is a service combining consulting and BPO. It provides industry-specific services such as "C-mo Pro gourmet" for restaurants, "C-mo Pro beauty" for beauty salons and beauty parlors, "C-mo Pro travel" for ryokan and hotels, and "C-mo Pro togo," which strengthens takeout and delivery.
entries.4a4d7e65fd5d5de3: The company's mission is: 'Provide the next stage to those involved with “Ｃ” and bring smiles to their faces.' In its core Local Business DX Business, the company is focusing on strengthening the functions of 'C-mo' and enhancing its support system, as well as strengthening its direct sales structure and expanding collaboration with alliance companies, with the priorities of improving customer satisfaction and expanding market share. In addition to the gourmet, beauty and travel industries, the company aims to expand its business areas by extending services to other industries and creating new solutions in areas beyond marketing.
entries.4fe39edbef6a2582: This is the Group's core business. It provides services that contribute to DX promotion in marketing and to improved business performance for store-based businesses rooted in local communities (local businesses), such as restaurants, beauty salons and beauty parlors, and ryokan and hotels. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥2,732 million.

entries.fe28f68cbc668833: CS-C.Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2011 and has its head office in Minato-ku, Tokyo; it forms a group with the company and two consolidated subsidiaries, and had 173 employees (as of September 30, 2025).
